## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap should be reduced to five because the new helper exceeds the governing project policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retry wrapper, retry tests, and a review fixture. It also proposes raising the documented retry cap from five to ten.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — For a persistently failing URL, the default makes ten attempts, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The validation also accepts explicit limits above five. — When an upstream remains unavailable, callers generate excess requests and wait longer than the required retry budget permits. — Fix: Cap the default and accepted attempts at five, and update the default-count and range tests accordingly.
